pages.text: A reward bag is a random supply reward. The revised basic pools make one draw: you receive one possible stack, rather than every item in the pool. Workshop themes favor useful supplies, such as AE2 assembly materials or ordinary Botania mystical flowers.

Rarity improves the basic supply stacks; it does not promise a finished machine or relic. These bags do not bypass dimension encounters, NPC deliveries or awakening. Keep following JEI and the questbook for the projects those materials support.
